text.tspan: CO₂ emissions from fossil fuels and land-use change World
Carbon dioxide emissions from fossil fuels and land-use change, measured in tonnes per year.

tspan.tspan: Emissions from land-use change can be positive or negative depending on whether carbon is emitted or sequestered.
